Thanks ;) Something I've left off the description -- You'll note that I said I'd gotten 52 edge pieces. It wasn't until a few months after I'd built it that it dawned on me how each piece was made up of 7 cylinders… 7 and 52 finally rang some bells… 7 days a week. 52 weeks in a year. I'd accidentally made a crude calendar! So that last picture is how my year starts on the December solstice, with my "daystone" put up on the first cylinder of the year. Then, every day I walk to the center and on the way out, I move the "daystone" to the next cylinder. Once it falls off the end at the outer edge of the spiral, I bring it back to the center where it sits on the center hexagonal paver until the solstice. That lets me deal with the missing 365th cylinder and with leap years.
